Not so lucky was Frenchman Julien Kapek, in group B, whose best of 16.74 metres came with his third and last jump. This placed him 13th overall with the 12th and last qualifying place having been bagged at 16.75!

He leapt into the final with a 17.07m opening effort. 17.10m was the automatic qualifier but Phillips was, rightly, confident that his initial mark would be sufficient and he sat out the remaining two rounds. Competing for France, Julien Kapek was unable to qualify.
